- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.27) and price is rising, model tends to over-forecast; reduce forecast slightly to avoid overshoot.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >80), model often overreacts and forecasts higher than true; cap forecast at +5% above recent peak or use lagged mean.
- If sentiment is negative (≤ -0.23) and price is falling, model under-forecasts; adjust upward by 2–3% to avoid underreaction.
- Model consistently overestimates 30-day mean by 1–2% in early cycles; apply a 1% downward bias to 30d forecast mean.
- When sentiment is volatile (alternating +/–), model exhibits lag; delay forecast adjustment by 1–2 days to match sentiment momentum.
- If recent 7-day mean is rising, model often fails to capture momentum; use 7-day moving average as a smoother baseline for 30d forecast.
